# anthropic_federation_rule (Resource)

Manages a Workload Identity Federation rule (`fdrl_…`) — binds an issuer's JWTs (matched by subject/audience/claims/CEL) to a service account and OAuth scope.

Requires the provider's `oauth_token` (an `org:admin` OAuth bearer token). OAuth callers may only manage rules scoped `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`.

~> **Experimental (beta).** The Workload Identity Federation endpoints are not exercised by the provider's CI acceptance tests, which run with an Admin API key only (no `org:admin` OAuth token). Treat this resource as beta and verify its behavior in your own organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bind GitHub Actions main-branch deploys to a service account.
resource "anthropic_federation_rule" "gha_deploy" {
  name      = "gha-deploy"
  issuer_id = anthropic_federation_issuer.github_actions.id

  match = {
    subject_prefix = "repo:my-org/my-repo:ref:refs/heads/main"
    claims = {
      repository_owner = "my-org"
    }
  }

  target = {
    service_account_id = anthropic_service_account.inference_worker.id
  }

  workspace_id           = "wrkspc_xxxxx"
  oauth_scope            = "workspace:developer"
  token_lifetime_seconds = 600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_id` (String) ID of the federation issuer (`fdis_…`) this rule applies to.
- `match` (Attributes) Conditions an incoming JWT must satisfy. At least one of `subject_prefix`, `claims`, or `condition` must be set; all configured matchers must pass. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `name` (String) Name of the rule. Must match `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, 1–255 chars, unique within the organization.
- `target` (Attributes) The service account a matched JWT maps to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target))

### Optional

- `applies_to_all_workspaces` (Boolean) Enable the rule in all workspaces instead of a single `workspace_id`. Changing forces replacement (the API has no in-place update for this field).
- `oauth_scope` (String) OAuth scope granted on the minted token. Defaults to `workspace:developer`. OAuth callers may only set `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`.
- `token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of the minted token in seconds (60–86400). Defaults to 3600.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the rule is enabled in at creation. Either this or `applies_to_all_workspaces` is required. Changing forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the rule was archived, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the rule was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the federation rule (`fdrl_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Optional:

- `audience` (String) Exact `aud` claim to require.
- `claims` (Map of String) Map of exact claim values the JWT must carry.
- `condition` (String) A [CEL](https://cel.dev/) expression for complex match logic.
- `subject_prefix` (String) Match on the `sub` claim. Exact match unless it ends in `*` (prefix match).


<a id="nestedatt--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target`

Required:

- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the target service account (`svac_…`).

Optional:

- `type` (String) Target type. Defaults to `service_account`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing federation rule by its ID
terraform import anthropic_federation_rule.gha_deploy fdrl_xxxxx
```
